affected_kernel: FlashInfer MLA sparse SM90 index_kpool handling
evidence_snippet: the query token and up to two before it are unread by attention on three of four positions past 2048 tokens.
rationale: SM90 sparse MLA used an index_kpool default mismatched with the model config, leaving query tokens unread and corrupting outputs.
counterfactual_rationale: A sparse MLA reference test varying index_kpool and long-context positions would catch unread-token corruption; tool-call workloads amplified it.

affected_kernel: XpuCommunicator tensor-parallel communication
evidence_snippet: Tensor parallel for xpu is broken after upgrade to Torch 2.5.
rationale: The XPU tensor-parallel path needed a dedicated communicator after the PyTorch 2.5 upgrade; without it XPU TP was broken.
counterfactual_rationale: An XPU tensor-parallel inference job in the hardware matrix would detect communicator breakage after dependency upgrades.

affected_kernel: ROCm AITER fused-MoE backend selection for Quark W4A4
introducing_evidence: #39801 accidentally switched off `rocm_aiter_fused_moe` for all quark-quantized W4A4 models
evidence_snippet: forcing them to use the `MXFP4.Emulation` backend instead.
rationale: A prior change removed W4A4 from AITER support, forcing supported ROCm hardware onto an emulation backend instead of fused MoE.
counterfactual_rationale: ROCm quantization/performance tests on MXFP4-capable hardware would reveal that W4A4 no longer dispatches to AITER.

affected_kernel: Triton DCP prefill GQA head mapping
introducing_evidence: After #32858, K/V heads are replicated within a DCP group while Q heads remain sharded.
evidence_snippet: This corrupted every fresh prompt's prefill and reduced GSM8K accuracy from the expected ~0.95 to 0.75-0.77.
rationale: Triton DCP prefill inferred local rather than global GQA mapping after KV replication, corrupting TP/DCP prefill outputs.
counterfactual_rationale: A layout unit test over TP/DCP/GQA head mappings can catch the shard-selection bug; E2E evals reveal the accuracy drop.

affected_kernel: modelopt_quant num_experts passed to trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe
evidence_snippet: the API checks for the routing_logits dim to be consistent with num_experts(global). But previously ... num_experts is overwritten by num_local_experts.
rationale: ModelOpt quantization passed local expert counts into an API requiring global expert counts, breaking FP4 MoE EP/TP backend checks.
counterfactual_rationale: The mismatch appears in model-level EP/TP FP4 MoE execution with real routing logits, so an E2E quantized MoE test is appropriate.

affected_kernel: RotaryEmbedding backend selection with Triton attention
evidence_snippet: Since flashinfer is still being used, the unsupported head_dim: 80 error still occurs when doing `--attention-backend triton`.
rationale: Triton attention still routed RotaryEmbedding through FlashInfer for EXAONE head_dim 80, causing an unsupported-head-dimension crash.
counterfactual_rationale: A full model startup/generation test with head_dim 80 and Triton backend would expose the selection mismatch.

affected_kernel: ROCm AITER FP4 BMM and ASM GEMM feature gates
evidence_snippet: FP4 BMM and FP4 ASM GEMM use CDNA4-only instructions available only on gfx950 ... on MI300X (gfx942) would crash with illegal instruction errors.
rationale: ROCm FP4 operations using gfx950-only instructions were exposed on gfx942; the fix gates them off on unsupported hardware.
counterfactual_rationale: A ROCm hardware matrix including MI300X/gfx942 and gfx950 would catch unsupported-instruction crashes.

affected_kernel: trtllm_gen_mla decode CUDA-graph workspace
evidence_snippet: trtllm_gen_mla took empty-init decode_cuda_graph_workspace. Replaced by zero_init self.workspace_buffer
rationale: TRTLLM-GEN MLA used an uninitialized decode CUDA-graph workspace; zero-initializing removes stale data effects.
counterfactual_rationale: A dynamic initcheck-style tool would flag reads from uninitialized workspace memory; accuracy evals can reveal downstream effects.

affected_hardware: GPU quantized MoE models (AMD GPT-OSS tests)
affected_kernel: Fused MoE weight multiplication/bias/dequantization order
evidence_snippet: This PR fixes computation flow as: ... dequantization ... bias addition ... MoE weight multiplication in float32 ... cast
rationale: Fused MoE applied routed weights, dequantization, and bias in an order that lost intended float32 semantics for quantized/bias MoE models.
counterfactual_rationale: The wrong order matters for quantized models with bias and routed weights, so realistic quantized-model distributions are likely to expose it.

affected_hardware: DeepSeek-V4 context parallel prefill on GPUs
affected_kernel: DSA CP round-robin split row pitch consumed by downstream kernels
evidence_snippet: A size-1 outer dimension imposes no contiguity constraint ... Any kernel that takes its row pitch from `stride(0)` then treats the shard as `cp_size` times larger.
rationale: When a CP shard had one row, `.contiguous()` did not fix inflated stride, so downstream kernels sized descriptors from an 8x row pitch and faulted.
counterfactual_rationale: A shape-edge test where tokens exactly equal cp_size would expose the inflated single-row stride; sanitizer would catch the GPU fault.

affected_kernel: FlashInfer top-p/top-k sampler integration
evidence_snippet: we have errors when using FlashInfer>=v0.2.3 for top-p & top-k sampling ... sampling API removes the success return value
rationale: A FlashInfer sampling API change broke vLLM's top-p/top-k integration, so the fix disables that path by default for affected versions.
counterfactual_rationale: An end-to-end sampling test running top-p/top-k with FlashInfer 0.2.3 would catch the API incompatibility.

affected_kernel: TRTLLM MoE FP4 renormalization path

affected_hardware: NVIDIA TRTLLM FP4 MoE with MTP
affected_kernel: FlashInfer TRTLLM FP4 MoE backend selection for quantized/unquantized methods
evidence_snippet: `FlashInferFP4MoE` ... only supports the modelopt_fp4 quantized method and fails with unquantized ones. ... fall back to `FusedMoE`.
rationale: MTP could introduce unquantized MoE layers into a path selecting the FP4-only FlashInfer backend; the fix falls back when quantization config is absent.
counterfactual_rationale: A full MTP model test with mixed quantized and unquantized MoE layers would exercise the backend-selection fallback.

affected_kernel: FlashInfer fused MoE backend sharing between EP and TP
introducing_evidence: This PR fixes a breakage caused by [this PR](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/8552).
evidence_snippet: everything (TP or EP MoE) should use `FlashInferFusedMoE` for trtllm-gen backends.
rationale: A previous backend split broke TRTLLM-GEN MoE use; routing EP and TP through the shared FlashInfer fused MoE backend restored quantized tests.
counterfactual_rationale: The evidence comes from full DeepSeek FP8/FP4 accuracy tests under backend flags, so E2E quantized-model tests are plausible.

affected_hardware: AMD AITER attention with DP attention
affected_kernel: AITER persistent MLA decode kernel selection
evidence_snippet: each GPU sees all 128 heads instead of 16, causing the persistent MLA decode kernel to be incorrectly selected ... leading to accuracy issues.
rationale: DP attention changed effective attention TP size so head count exceeded persistent MLA support, but the selection guard missed it.
counterfactual_rationale: A DP-attention E2E accuracy test on AMD with TP8/DP8 would reveal the backend-selection error.

affected_kernel: CPU C++ OpenMP-dependent kernel sources
evidence_snippet: build would fail with errors like `error: ‘omp_get_max_threads’ was not declared in this scope`
rationale: Certain RISC-V/OpenMP toolchains did not expose OpenMP declarations to CPU kernel sources, causing native extension compilation failures.
counterfactual_rationale: A RISC-V/native CPU build job with the affected GCC/OpenMP toolchain would catch the missing header.

affected_kernel: cache_kernels.cu DSA/MTP cache update
evidence_snippet: This PR fixes the IMA bug when using DSA with MTP.
rationale: A prior cache-kernel change introduced an illegal memory access in DSA plus MTP; this repairs CUDA cache kernel indexing.
counterfactual_rationale: Compute-sanitizer on a DSA+MTP cache-kernel test would flag the illegal access directly.

rationale: An assertion added to the ROCm AITER fused MoE path blocked valid Llama4 BF16/unquantized configurations during startup.

affected_hardware: NVIDIA Blackwell / TRTLLM MHA FP8 KV cache

rationale: TRTLLM MHA FP8 KV-cache omitted Q/K/V scale factors when handing tensors to FlashInfer, causing NVFP4 quality drops.
counterfactual_rationale: Scale-handling errors may only show up on real FP8 KV-cache/NVFP4 model values, so model accuracy distributions are needed.
